sourceChecks.text: Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in his father David’s city; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: They sent and called him; and Jeroboam and all Israel came, and they spoke to Rehoboam, saying,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men, who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What counsel do you give me about how to answer these people?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: The king answered them roughly; and King Rehoboam abandoned the counsel of the old men,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: Then King Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and the children of Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled the house of Judah and Benjamin, one hundred eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: “Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem, and built cities for defense in Judah.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong for three years, for they walked three years in the way of David and Solomon.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: Rehoboam took a wife for himself, Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David and of Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: Rehoboam loved Maacah the granddaughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines; for he took eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and became the father of twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: Rehoboam appointed Abijah the son of Maacah to be chief, the prince among his brothers, for he intended to make him king.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: When the kingdom of Rehoboam was established and he was strong, he abandoned the LORD’s law, and all Israel with him.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had trespassed against the LORD,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: Now Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and to the princes of Judah, who were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said to them, “The LORD says, ‘You have forsaken me, therefore I have also left you in the hand of Shishak.’”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who kept the door of the king’s house.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: So King Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem and reigned; for Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, aren’t they written in the histories of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer, in the genealogies? There were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in David’s city; and Abijah his son reigned in his place.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。

sourceChecks.text: Worthless men were gathered to him, wicked fellows who strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tender hearted, and could not withstand them.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に対象名があり、指定の親子・役割・所属をこの節の文脈に限定して確認。
